rapport_notes: Nicole was consistently warm, patient with the customer's brief responses, and used his name; maintained professional, encouraging tone throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'Does that make sense so far?' but did not hold silence for a response before continuing with the close; customer asked a clarification question at the end but rep did not pause for full silence after the close question before wrapping up.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I can go ahead and create approval for you so I can get the details of your move and provide you an accurate estimate. This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes.
evidence_quotes.agenda_asked_but_after_probing: Before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep_not_present: Customer answered 'No ma'am' to the agenda question; no follow-up such as 'what else' or 'tell me more' was attempted.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_damage_coverage: We have no worries. Damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_meet_your_mover: We have a meter mover feature a few days before the move. You will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you. You can see their photos and basic info.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: You will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical 1200 square footage home, it usually takes around six to eight hours to completely move locally in your case since you're moving from a one story house with a half full garage. Moving to a third floor apartment with 35 minutes. Drive time. I will estimate this move to take around eight to nine hours.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: We will be charging you for the total time consumed by the end of the move.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Once we go over the minimum the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: You can disassemble and reassemble it on your own so you can save more time with Einstein and save more.

top_strength: Nicole delivered all four critical differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, and communication/day-before email) in a natural, conversational flow during the takeaway, and anchored the estimate with both a typical range and personalization to the customer's specific situation (one-story house, third-floor apartment, 35-minute drive).
coaching_note: The agenda question was asked too late—after Nicole had already probed logistics for 10+ minutes—and when the customer said 'No ma'am' to any concerns, Nicole did not follow up with 'what else' or dig deeper; always probe the customer's actual priorities before launching into your own information delivery.
